Use Your Vote. This site is your official hub for voting in Maryland. From registration to the ballot box, we're here to help you prepare for and participate in every election! [Voter Services](https://voterservices.elections.maryland.gov/) Register to vote, update your info, request a ballot, & more. [Get Involved](https://results.elections.maryland.gov/get_involved/index.html) Find out how _you_ can participate in the elections process. [Rumor Control](https://results.elections.maryland.gov/press_room/rumor_control.html) Get the facts from SBE: the only official source for election info. ## At a Glance Who Are We? We are the Maryland State Board of Elections: the official government body in charge of ensuring compliance with the requirements of Maryland and federal election laws by all persons involved in the election process. Our Mission Our mission is to empower all eligible Marylanders with the ability to exercise their right to vote in a free, secure, and transparent manner, inspiring confidence and trust in the electoral process. Our Vision Our vision is to be a national leader in Election Administration by ensuring we are able to **V** erify procedures and results, promote **O** pen processes, be the **T** rusted source of election information, and **E** mpower Marylanders with integrity and fairness. ## Notable Events | Jun 25 | [Next Board Meeting](https://results.elections.maryland.gov/about/board.html)

metadata.description: The State Board of Elections provides all eligible citizens of the State convenient access to voter registration; provides all registered voters accessible locations in which they may exercise their right to vote, to ensure uniformity of election practices; to promote fair and equitable elections; and to maintain registration records, campaign fund reports, and other election-related data accurately and in a form that is accessible to the public.
